title: Noise space / a coherent ground nobody designed
question: How can ground be random and smooth at once under the feet?
reference: A fractal-noise heightfield with matching trimesh collision. In a slot it fits the pool floor and fades to it at the edges.
physical_model: Static ground. Height is FastNoiseLite(x, z) scaled by height_scale; the walker's feet meet a trimesh of the same vertices.

slot.note: Fitted by TopologySpace.fit_slot: footprint minus the margin, the lowest point on the pool floor, the highest 0.1 m under the rim, the relief fading to the floor across the edge band. Also stands alone with no slot.
